usage: The phrase is used to describe a situation where there is no space left between people or objects, implying extreme crowding or congestion.
It can be applied both literally, such as in describing densely packed places, and metaphorically, such as in expressing crowded schedules or intense competition.
Typically used in contexts involving physical crowding but also conveys the idea of an impenetrable barrier or obstacle due to tight packing.
The phrase has a negative connotation often implying discomfort or difficulty due to the tightness of space.
It can emphasize both physical and abstract situations where nothing can pass through or fit in due to the density or compactness.
